text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went shopping at a sporting goods 
store, I saw two Tracen Academy Umamusume 
looking at the merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon is an Umamusume with a 
cynical aura, always cool and possessing a 
bit of a sharp tongue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And, boasting superhuman strength and 
loving hard training, the competitive 
Umamusume, Bitter Glace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are Umamusume trained by my 
acquaintance, Trainer Kashimoto. I had 
thought they weren't the type to hang 
around others much, but—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Trainer <username>! What a 
coincidence!
choice_data_list:
It's rare to see the two of you together 
on a day off.

It's rare to see the two of you together 
on a day off.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Mind your own business. We're not here 
to play best friends.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Little Cocon... The reason I 
came here today is to share some 
information.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Little Cocon turning away, Bitter 
Glace explained in her stead, telling us 
that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two are sharing their impressions of 
the sports gear they've used so far, 
hoping to propose better options to 
Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Of course I trust Trainer Kashimoto. She 
never makes a mistake with her choices.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
It's just, that person... she's always 
staring down reviews of shoes and 
sportswear for our sake, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to lighten your load, even a 
little bit. Our 'Year 3' is fast 
approaching, after all!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe you are already aware, 
but... the third year of the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...Out of the most important three years 
for us Umamusume, this is the final one."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Gotta brace myself. Yeah, I'm getting 
fired up!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...And? What about you? Do you really have 
time to be loafing around in a place like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Hah... if you're daydreaming, you'll get 
tripped up. Both you and your partner.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Well, we're gonna get going now.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haha, and that's that! Well then, give my 
regards to <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting deeply on their words, I 
decided to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one staying late until this hour was 
Happy Meek, the Umamusume trained by my 
peer, Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Always quiet and expressionless. While she 
might appear to be merely spacing out, her 
bond with Trainer Kiryuin is stronger than 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Ah... <username> Trainer... Good evening.
choice_data_list: Is Trainer Kiryuin not with you?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Being... "cooped up" in the trainer's 
office? ...Yes. I'm very busy.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I'm resting during that time... but... I 
just can't sit still.
choice_data_list: And that kept you up this late?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Right now, Trainer is holed up working 
on a deadline...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
They're remaking... my training menu for 
my "third year" for me.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I'm tellin' you...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my best too. ...Together with 
you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Also... your partner was... working really 
hard, too. So...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, one more run. Fight, oh-.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Feeling somewhat intrigued by what 
Happy Meek had said, I decided to drop by 
the Trainer's Room.
choice_data_list: The lights in the room are on...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Also... your partner was... working really 
hard, too. So...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... is <chrname> also thinking about 
something for our 'third year'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And right there—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I spent time chatting about 
all sorts of things with her as she waited 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a night where I truly felt the 
undeniable bond between <chrname> and me!
